summary: T7-02 (commit 74bb51c, base e095c98) meets every acceptance criterion on evidence I gathered myself. make check, make test and the targeted vitest run all pass. I found no blocker or high-severity defect. The review ran under Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) with Bash, Read and Grep. I did not run the tests-first-and-failing step, because I could only inspect the final state. I also didn't open the full test body line by line, so my reading of the tests rests on test names, grep results and passing runs.

checks.evidence: ruff, mypy, eslint and tsc all succeed. turbo reports 4/4 tasks successful, replayed from cache.
pytest 404 passed. web vitest 9 files and 174 tests passed. schema vitest 157 passed. All were turbo cache replays, so I did not re-execute them. The targeted run below did execute.
1 file passed, 50 tests passed. This run was a real execution, not a cache replay.

checks.criterion: Tests written first and cover each of the five labels rendering its text, plus a type-level check that no other string compiles
checks.evidence: evidence-label.test.tsx has 50 tests. Lines 140 and 189-192 use @ts-expect-error for 'Measured' and for case variants. tsc passes in make check, so those directives are live. Tests-first ordering was not verified, because I only saw the final state.

checks.criterion: EvidenceLabel: five-value union, label text plus PRD 3 meaning as accessible description, distinct non-colour treatment per label
checks.evidence: evidence-label.tsx:16-27 holds the meanings. I compared them with PRD.md:124-128 and they are verbatim. Line 68 sets aria-describedby, and line 73 renders the meaning as sr-only or visible text. Lines 45-51 give each label a distinct border style or width, and line 234 tests that every pair differs in greyscale.

checks.criterion: LabelledValue: {label, value, unit, source}; value shown only when not Unavailable; Unavailable requires and renders a reason; missing value is a type error and never 0, empty or a dash
checks.evidence: labelled-value.tsx:10-31 is a discriminated union. Value labels need value, unit and source. Unavailable needs reason and forbids value and unit. Runtime guards at lines 35-56 and 69-73 refuse null, NaN, a blank string, dashes and n/a. Tests at lines 306-354 cover these cases, including @ts-expect-error.

checks.criterion: EvidenceLegend is a server component listing the five labels with PRD 3 meanings; sentence unaltered
checks.evidence: evidence-legend.tsx:8 holds the sentence, which matches PRD.md:120. It has no use-client directive. The test at evidence-label.test.tsx:435-438 asserts that none of the components uses a client directive. Tests at lines 399-426 check the sentence and the meanings.

checks.criterion: No numbers, targets or claims in components; tests use synthetic values
checks.evidence: The component sources contain no domain figures. Test line 442 asserts that no digit is added to the page text. The value-label tests use synthetic values, and the 0 case checks that zero is rendered as a value.

checks.criterion: Typecheck, lint and Vitest pass; no client directive
checks.evidence: All three passed in the checks above. Test lines 435-438 enforce the no-directive rule.

checks.criterion: Changed paths stay within the story's files list
checks.evidence: Changed files are the three components, the test, tests/tailwind.ts, tests/theme.test.ts and vitest.config.ts. All fall under apps/web/tests/* or the listed files. tests/theme.test.ts only has its helpers moved into tests/tailwind.ts, and those tests still pass. There are no changes to config/run.yaml, package.json or the lockfile, and the working tree is clean apart from a log file.

findings.claim: The placeholder regex may over-refuse a legitimate string value such as 'none' or 'unknown' for an Observed or Derived label. It would also let a placeholder like 'TBD' through.
findings.evidence: PLACEHOLDER matches blank, dashes, ?, n/a, nan, null, undefined, none and unknown. The behaviour is stricter than the criterion requires and fails safe. It is a judgement call, not a defect.

resolution.reason: Fixed in 5a529dd (failing tests first in 4f24fcd). The PLACEHOLDER pattern in apps/web/components/labelled-value.tsx now also refuses a value that is only TBD, TBC, TBA or missing, in any case and with surrounding blanks. Such a value is a marker for evidence that is not there, and PRD 3 labels missing evidence Unavailable with a reason, so the build fails instead of showing it. None and unknown stay refused on purpose. A value labelled Observed, Derived, Predicted or Assumed that reads only unknown or none is missing evidence presented as a value, which section 3 and CLAUDE.md forbid. Refusing it fails next build loudly and names label Unavailable, so nothing is hidden; a record that means a real result can say so in words (for example "no detection"). The pattern is anchored, so a value that merely contains one of these words still renders. New tests show test-none-value, "test-value tbd" and unknown-test-value. pnpm --filter @terraluna/web exec vitest run components/evidence-label.test.tsx: 57 passed (4 failed before the fix).

findings.claim: The include list was widened to components/**, which the story's file list allows. Colocated component tests now run in the default `vitest run`, which is intended.
findings.evidence: `make test` shows components/evidence-label.test.tsx among the 9 files. No action needed.

resolution.reason: Rebutted: this is not a defect, and the finding says no action is needed. vitest.config.ts is in the story files list. Widening include to components/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} is what makes the story check `pnpm --filter @terraluna/web exec vitest run components/evidence-label.test.tsx` find the colocated test at all. Before the change Vitest collected only tests/**, as the Codebase Patterns entry from T7-01 records. The same include serves the colocated tests that T7-03 to T7-06 name in their checks. make test runs 9 web test files and 181 tests, including this one.
